scripts.db:generate: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma; else DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/hitlink_dev?schema=public" prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma; fi'
